name: Tsukishima Chihane
source:
A first-year student at Seishin Academy, she is [url=/c121753]Yuuki Airi[/url]'s classmate and best friend. She is a beautiful, pure Japanese girl with a reserved personality. Her mother is an accomplished woman in Japanese cooking while also teaching classes on the act of kimono dressing.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/saiminseishidou/character_page013.html]official site[/url]]
